objective: Improve the current V2 CatBoost through joint data, application features, algorithm-specific preparation, hyperparameters and development-selected ensembles.
primary_metric: sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score on raw ranking scores; unweighted validation population
population: Accepted 36-month loans with Fully Paid/Charged Off outcome; no prediction claim for rejected applicants or unresolved loans.
information_scope: Application and origination bureau fields only, before LC pricing. Exclude grade, sub_grade, int_rate, installment, payment, recoveries, later FICO, hardship and settlement fields.
search: Seeded TPE per family, joint feature mode, preparation, start year and recency weighting; known V2 settings queued. First-fold median pruning after 5 startup trials. Failed and pruned trials retained.
controlled_ablations: Fixed V2 LightGBM parameters and identical validation rows: baseline, financial, context, combined, clipping, from-2013, recency12, recency24. No early stopping in this block; isolates each intervention.
promotions: Top configuration of every family plus runner-up CatBoost and LightGBM, exact V2 CatBoost fallback, and best feature-only LightGBM ablation. Refit all training rows through June 2014; tree counts are the rounded mean CV best iteration times 1.15, capped by searched limit. Exact V2 control keeps original count.
selection_rule: Highest raw AP on identical complete 2014 Q3 cohort among prespecified candidates and ensembles. Report both earlier temporal folds and Q3 separately; do not claim consistent gain if signs differ.
postselection_stability: After Q3 choice, re-evaluate the fixed selected specification and fixed V2 CatBoost parameters on both earlier folds, same 60000/20000 caps, without early stopping. Diagnostic only: no reselection. For SVM ensemble mappings, fit using only scores/labels available by the corresponding fold training end, otherwise report that blend fold unavailable; do not fit a future mapping.
ensembles: Generate fixed probability blends of V2 CatBoost and each new family winner at CatBoost weights 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, plus equal-weight top-three distinct-family tree models. Probability scale for SVM uses sigmoid fitted on earlier fold out-of-time scores. Select weights using Q3 only; no benchmark tuning. Also test average of seeds 42 and 2026 for best new CatBoost configuration, selected before benchmark.
calibration: December split deterministically by SHA256(id) parity: even for calibration, odd for thresholds. Disjoint same-month groups, not chronological sub-month periods. Positive-slope sigmoid only. Raw AP primary. All V3 finalists train through November, adding 43146 loans versus V2; include same V2 parameters with these dates as a separate data-volume control. The exact frozen V2 model remains the reference.
finalists: Freeze/evaluate the selected strategy, V2-parameter CatBoost with extra training data and each promoted family winner. The final refit through November is predeclared even if Q3 retains the V2 parameter recipe; it remains an experiment, not an assumed improvement. Always retain the exact frozen V2 predictor and compare it separately. No replacement by another finalist based on benchmark ranking.
benchmark_primary: Same 258856 2015/36-month IDs used in V2, excluding original sample and preview IDs.
benchmark_secondary: Same 212482 2016/36-month terminal loans, censored temporal stress only.
benchmark_role: Previously observed, reused retrospective benchmarks. NOT a new independent final test. No tuning or model replacement after opening V3 benchmark predictions.
limits: 2017/18 remain heavily unresolved; filtering terminal outcomes cannot create a mature independent test.
Unknown historical label-availability dates prevent an as-of deployment simulation.
Primary AP changes across populations/prevalences cannot be interpreted as model improvements.
Paired bootstrap conditions on this reused sample and does not correct adaptive selection history.
No claim that this finite CPU search finds the globally optimal model.
